assumptions: Finding message texts are free-form (spec pins no wording): 'required key is missing', 'expected <type>, got "<value>"', 'expected one of <list>, got "<value>"'
checkSchema rejects null and non-object primitives as well as arrays (PD-7 'any other shape')
When a value fails both type and enum, both findings are emitted (type first) for that key
check() trusts its schema already passed checkSchema (UC precondition) and does not re-validate it
required:false or absent with no pair yields no finding; type/enum are judged only when the pair is present
